Definition: Sakar, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name is Sakar, the name of two Israelites. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 11:35, "Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal…", and again in 1 Chronicles 26:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sakar matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
